outcome: late or no prenatal care initiation
cohort: Participants were US resident mothers aged 24 years or younger (n = 5,669,824) identified from birth registrations between 2014 and 2019.
finding: Marriage among mothers below age 18 is associated with both adverse (e.g., prior pregnancy termination, repeat birth, maternal smoking, infant morbidity) and favorable (e.g., lower odds of late prenatal care, STIs, no breastfeeding) reproductive, maternal, and infant health indicators, with these associations showing heterogeneity across different adolescent maternal age groups.
